## Notes


### The CTC student's 100 h point (2026-10-09)

`06e_Student_Omnilingual` on the 2026-09-30 export, A100-SXM4 40 GB, the kit built at 0fd8cb2 (sha
ed2750e3), after a smoke run. The protocol of 06a–06d: stage 1 (*human*) from the
`omniASR_CTC_1B_v2` card on the 14,832 verified train clips (3 dropped: an unknown character, an
empty target or an impossible CTC alignment); stage 2 (*distill*) from stage 1 on those plus
blend-075's 21,368 pseudo-labels (79.5 h), half of each epoch's draws human; stage 3 skipped
itself. The pretrained character vocabulary and CTC head are kept, so unlike IndicConformer and
Parakeet no head starts fresh. bf16 autocast over float32 master weights, micro-batches of 7 clips
(132 s of padded audio), about 260× realtime. One seed. Folded WER is fold-v4.

**Training.** Before training, val 34.00 (26.34 / 6.03 / 1.63), printed by the run but not stored as
a run of its own. Stage 1, val by epoch: 21.91, 20.15, 18.64, 17.11, 16.21, 15.55, 15.12, 14.80,
14.48, 14.17, 13.84, 13.42, 13.33, 13.04, 13.10, 13.02, **12.93**: stopped by patience after 17 of 20
(three evaluations under 0.15 below 13.04), about 11.4 min an epoch. Stage 2: 13.42, 13.01, 13.01,
12.73, 12.50, 12.21, 11.78, 11.61, **11.55**, 11.56: all 10 epochs, about 31 min each, flat over the
last two as the learning rate ran out. No loops in the final scores.

The logged loss reads 50–90 where the other students read under 1: the recipe normalises the CTC
loss by clips, not tokens, so it is −log P(whole transcript) per clip.

**A power cut on 2026-10-09** took the owner's machine down at about 13:50 UTC, during stage 2's
epoch 7. The Colab runtime ran on without a browser through epoch 8 (its resume point reached
`Sagyam/nepanglish-asr-resume` at 15:05 UTC) and was gone before epoch 9's. Stage 2 was resumed
on a new runtime from that point about five hours later: weights, counters and history restored, the
optimizer's moments rebuilt. Epochs 9–10 are therefore the only ones trained after a fresh
AdamW state; nothing else differs.

| | val | gold | gold, no crosstalk | gold, >15% crosstalk |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| teacher (blend-075) | 7.08 | 10.85 | | |
| Omnilingual, stage 1 | 12.93 (9.85 / 1.81 / 1.27) | 19.65 (14.97 / 3.21 / 1.47) | 14.95 | 37.17 |
| Omnilingual, stage 2 | **11.55** (8.77 / 1.58 / 1.20) | **17.52** (13.26 / 2.91 / 1.35) | 13.21 | 33.47 |

- **Stage 2 minus stage 1: val −1.38 [−1.86, −1.03], gold −2.13 [−2.63, −1.62]**, from `evalkit`'s
  paired comparison. On gold it is largest on >15% crosstalk, −3.69 [−5.07, −1.88].
- **It closed 24% of the gap to the teacher on gold** (+8.80 → +6.67 [+6.07, +7.24]) and 24% on
  val (+5.85 → +4.47).
- **The gap is substitutions.** Gold deletions (2.91) are near Whisper's (2.67) and under
  IndicConformer's (4.57); substitutions are 13.26.
- **Raw WER is 23.24 on gold against 17.52 folded**: the fold accounts for 5.7 points (6.1 at
  stage 1), more than for any other student's stage 2. What it folds was not broken down here.
- **The lowest gold CER of any student, 9.84** (Whisper 9.93, IndicConformer 10.70, Gemma 4 E2B
  10.82), with a WER 2.5 points above Whisper's: more of its errors are small inside words.
- **Gold RTF 0.0037**: slower than IndicConformer (0.0013) and Parakeet (0.0008), faster than
  Whisper (0.0045).
- **Every public set improved**, stage 2 minus stage 1, folded: FLEURS −1.72 [−2.36, −1.03], SLR54
  −2.48 [−2.82, −2.15], Common Voice −1.40 [−2.54, −0.36], IndicVoices −2.53 [−2.93, −2.12],
  nepali_cs −1.69 [−2.24, −0.82]; mean 21.21 → 19.24. CER did not fall with it on FLEURS
  (12.83 → 14.23, plain) or Common Voice (9.47 → 9.87).

Stage 2 on every set, beside the other students' stage 2 (each from its own card; not paired):

| | val | gold | public mean |
|---|---|---|---|
| Whisper | 9.43 | 15.02 | 19.35 |
| Gemma 4 E2B | 10.88 | 15.41 | 18.63 |
| IndicConformer | 10.88 | 15.64 | 13.32 |
| **Omnilingual CTC 1B** | **11.55** | **17.52** | **19.24** |
| Parakeet | 13.79 | 21.53 | 26.92 |
| Conformer from scratch | 18.83 | 27.08 | 33.52 |

**What this does not show.**
- The learning-rate-restart confound of 06a–06d: stage 2 re-warms the schedule, and its control was
  not run. Stage 1 had flattened (0.11 over its last three epochs).
- One seed.
- Whether the gain is the CTC family or this checkpoint: the controlled pair is 06e against 07b
  (Omnilingual LLM-ASR 1B), which has not run.
